place:609.title: Priceline opaque Toyota Corolla
place:609.address: JFK Airport rental car facility / Federal Circle, Jamaica, NY
place:609.summary: Cheapest JFK option, but the supplier is hidden.
place:609.longDetails: Cheapest JFK option, but the supplier is hidden. Standard sedan is a good NYC compromise: more trunk than Corolla, easier to park than an SUV. Use it only if price matters more than knowing the counter experience before booking. Price/source: Live source $44/day, $306 total incl. taxes/fees. Source: Priceline JFK pricing page; exact dated checkout search hit anti-bot, so this is a source-priced JFK card/floor, not a booked reservation. JFK pickup/counter: Priceline hides the supplier until booking, so you lose the ability to judge the JFK counter before paying. Expect to leave the JetBlue terminal/baggage-claim flow and use AirTrain/signage to Federal Circle/rental-car facilities; build in extra time after landing. Car + NYC tradeoff: Standard sedan is a good NYC compromise: more trunk than Corolla, easier to park than an SUV. NYC reality: driving into Manhattan can be slow, toll-heavy, and stressful; parking/garages can be expensive and tight. A rental only makes sense if they need out-of-Manhattan flexibility, luggage control, or day trips—otherwise taxi/subway/rideshare may be easier. Review summary: no company-specific JFK confidence because the counter is unknown; choose only if the savings justify that uncertainty. Booking boundary: do not book/pay/accept insurance or toll terms without explicit approval. Before booking, verify exact Jun 23 pickup time, Jun 30 return time, taxes/fees, additional-driver policy, toll policy, fuel/EV policy, cancellation terms, and whether counter-skip/online check-in applies.
